rows.corpus_definition: A safe place where people go to get away from danger.
rows.example_en: The villagers found refuge in the old church.

rows.corpus_definition: To control a process or system with rules.
rows.example_en: New laws will regulate air pollution.

rows.corpus_definition: The process of getting back to normal after a sickness or injury.
rows.example_en: He began physical rehabilitation to walk again.

rows.corpus_definition: To make something stronger or more secure.
rows.example_en: The wooden beams reinforce the roof structure.
He was reluctant to share his private plans.

rows.corpus_definition: The act of telling your boss you are leaving.
rows.example_en: She handed in her resignation this morning.

rows.corpus_definition: A firm decision to do or not do something.
rows.example_en: I made a New Year resolution to exercise.

rows.corpus_definition: To continue to have or keep something.
rows.example_en: Try to retain all the new information.

rows.corpus_definition: To go and get something and bring it back.
rows.example_en: The dog ran to retrieve the ball for me.

rows.corpus_definition: Harming someone because they harmed you first.
rows.example_en: He wanted revenge for the broken promise.
